items.item_text: 01. I understand that all requested materials have been uploaded as attachments and are required for a complete application. This includes: 1.) Resume; 2.) A cover letter addressing the listed desirable qualifications, personal and professional qualities; 3.) A list of three (3) professional references including name, position, organization, phone number, email, and relationship to the applicant; 4.) Response to the following question: What does it mean to have a commitment to diversity, and how would you apply this commitment as you conduct your responsibilities in this position? Options: Yes | No

Ensures that the operation of the Financial Aid Department is in compliance with the state and federal regulations that govern federal student aid, state student aid, scholarships, disbursements, and the benefits provided to veteran students.
Ensures that departmental operations comply with organizational policies, collective bargaining agreements, and state/local regulations.
Makes determinations of student appeals to staff determinations related to financial aid.
Ensures that financial aid is disbursed according to disbursement dates.
Analyze data to ensure the accuracy of the data that is reported.
Completes federal, state, county, and District reports for area under responsibility.
Organizes financial aid outreach activities with other departments and areas.
Analyze departmental operations to assist in the assessment of departmental operations and services to determine if goals and objectives have been achieved.
Implements departmental policy changes, policy modifications, special assignments, goals, and objectives.
Analyze departmental expenditures and departmental needs to assist the supervising manager in approving the use of departmental funds, developing the departmental budget.
Engages and enforces the disciplinary process, if/when needed.
Participates in the District’s recruitment process to assist in hiring of classified and unclassified staff.
Apportions work amongst subordinate classified staff.
Analyze employee performance to develop performance evaluations and address performance issues.
Approves paid time off for employees under supervision.
Authorizes departmental personnel actions.
Effectively engage and support historically minoritized groups by addressing issues of equity and improving culturally responsive service-oriented practices.
Performs related duties as assigned.
State and federal regulations governing student financial aid, mandated reporting deadlines, and benefits for veteran students.
Maintain up to date on state and federal regulations governing financial aid and aid provided to veteran students.
District policies.
Ensure the accuracy of the data that is reported.
Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA).
Effectively counsel’s students and faculty regarding all financial aid issues.
State and federal databases related to financial aid.
Effectively adhere to collective bargaining contracts in the supervision of classified employees.
Collective bargaining agreements.
Effectively meet reporting deadlines.
District policies.
Effectively implement the level of service that is expect during all staff interactions.
Academic Management Systems.
Ensure that student documentation is filed appropriately.
Data gathering software.
Develop and maintain effective working relationships with District staff, students, and departmental visitors.
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Software.
Resume/Curriculum Vitae.
General office software and equipment.
A cover letter addressing the listed desirable qualifications and personal/professional qualities.
Use collective bargaining agreements to ensure compliance with negotiated language for all employees under supervision.
A list of three (3) professional references including name, position, organization, phone number, email, and relationship to the applicant.
Use academic management systems to review academic records.
Diversity question response: What does it mean to have a commitment to diversity, and how would you apply this commitment as you conduct your responsibilities in this position?
Use data gathering software to develop reports.
Use general ERP Software, state, and federal databases to monitor departmental budgets, financial aid accounts, and to ensure that financial aid information is reported.

Apply knowledge of the state and federal regulations that govern financial aid, mandated reporting deadlines, and benefits for veteran students, to ensure that the departmental day to day operations are in compliance, that mandated reports are completed at appropriate intervals, and that department financial aid records match state and federal allocated funds.
Communicate effectively, orally and in writing.
Apply knowledge of the state and federal regulations that govern veteran students to ensure that all certifying and reporting functions are in compliance.
Apply knowledge of FERPA to ensure that departmental practices do not disclose student information to unauthorized parties.
Use general office software and equipment to develop reports, aggregate data, and communicate with District staff and students.
